title: It Keeps Burning, Man!
description: It Keeps Burning, Man! — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 25 Mutant Fire Pincers, 25 Mutant Pukers, 25 Mutant Fire Hulks, 25 Mutant Fire Twins in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and return to Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp

Repeatable: Yes
